class.name: AudioEffectNoiseGate
class.brief_description: Adds a noise gate filter to the audio bus.
class.description: Attenuates or silences sound above [member threshold_db].

members.member: How long, in milliseconds, the gate takes to approach fully open, once the incoming sound gets loud enough to pass the [member threshold_db]. Short values let the start of a sound through almost instantly. Longer values soften or clip the beginning of each sound.
How much to attenuate (lower the volume) any audio lower than [member threshold_db]. -80 silences completely.
Flips the behavior. Attenuates audio [b]higher[/b] than [member threshold_db].

How long, in milliseconds, the gate takes to fully close once the incoming sound drops back below the [member threshold_db]. Short values shut the gate quickly. Longer values let the tail of a sound fade out naturally instead of cutting off abruptly.

The volume level, in decibels, that separates wanted sound from unwanted noise. Audio louder than this level opens the gate and passes through, while quieter audio is reduced by the [member attenuation_db]. Values closer to 0 require louder sound to open the gate, and more negative values let quieter sounds through.
